summary_en: AVAL DATA will tender all 800,000 shares of E-SOL (code 4420) held as policy holdings in a public tender offer by BCJ-110 at 820 yen per share, expected to generate approximately 596 million yen in investment securities gain in the fiscal year ending March 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Tender Offer for Shares Held by the Company and Expected Recognition of Special Gain
translation_en_brief:
AVAL DATA announced on September 10, 2026 that its board of directors resolved to tender all 800,000 shares of E-SOL Corporation (code 4420) held as policy holdings in a public tender offer (TOB) launched by BCJ-110. The tender price is 820 yen per share. The offer runs from September 2 to October 19, 2026, with settlement scheduled to begin on October 26, 2026.

AVAL DATA decided to participate after determining that the terms and conditions, including the purchase price, were reasonable and noting that E-SOL's board of directors expressed support for the offer. Should the TOB be completed at the planned price, AVAL DATA expects to receive approximately 656 million yen in proceeds from the sale of all E-SOL shares it holds.

Upon completion of the transaction, the company projects recording an investment securities gain (special gain) of approximately 596 million yen in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027.
